The graphics card was tested in twelve games at four K resolution. Average frame rates were about thirty percent higher than the previous generation, while power draw stayed close to five hundred and seventy five watts. Temperatures peaked at seventy two degrees on the core and eighty eight degrees on the memory. Fan noise remained acceptable under load, although coil whine was audible in menus with uncapped frame rates. Overall, the card is the fastest consumer GPU we have measured, but its price makes it hard to recommend for most players.
